rationale: NO. Executive Order 12248 of October 16, 1980 (45 FR 69199, sec. 1-202) states: "Executive Orders No. 12165 of October 12, 1979 and No. 12200 of March 12, 1980 are superseded." EO 12200 (45 FR 16443) only adds footnotes to, substitutes Schedules 1-7 of, corrects and extends (Schedule 8) the EO 12165 pay schedules; 12248 reissues schedules for every pay system it covered, so no part continues. The OFR catalog note ("Superseded by: EO 12248, October 16, 1980") and the 1989 codification row ("Supersededby EO 12248") agree; the 1989 snapshot is not relied on as basis. No earlier end or partial survival located; accrued pay under the old rates is a saving, not a continuing command. History has two observations and no flags.
